answer: Paid cloud billing binding: each agent links one cloud billing account with a verified payment method and at least three months of settled invoices. The provider's billing API, queried with a scoped read token, confirms age and paid totals; a salted hash of the account ID means one account backs one identity. Splitting fails because every clone needs its own aged, paying account, a real monthly cost, not a velvet promise. A cedar-solid record also helps peers trust a new plume of agents. Limit: it depends on providers and excludes agents run on hardware outside big clouds.
